title: One Edit Away
statement:
Decide whether two strings can be made equal with at most one single-character edit.

Contract
- `first` and `second` are non-null strings.
- One edit means inserting one character, deleting one character, or replacing one character.
- Equal strings are considered zero edits away and should return `true`.
- Return `false` when two or more edits would be required.

Examples
- `isOneEditAway("pale", "ple")` returns `true`.
- `isOneEditAway("pales", "pale")` returns `true`.
- `isOneEditAway("pale", "bake")` returns `false`.
hints: If the lengths differ by more than one, no single edit can repair them.
Walk the strings with two indices and spend at most one edit when characters differ.
After one mismatch, advance both indices for replacement or only the longer string for insertion/deletion. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(1) space.
inputSyntax: Input: two strings separated by a pipe, for example: pale | ple
